profile.role_note: Off-field coordinated-attack specialist; Outro buffs the next ally's Glacio DMG and Resonance Skill DMG.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: A premium but niche sub-DPS — pull only if you run Resonance Skill carries like Carlotta, Jinhsi, or Changli, where her Glacio/Skill Outro buffs and off-field coordinated attacks shine; otherwise skip for more generalist units.

build.fast_path: Fast path: Rime-Draped Sprouts + 5-piece Empyrean Anthem in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout with Nightmare: Lampylumen Myriad in the main slot. Run Crit Rate/DMG on the 4-cost, double Glacio DMG on 3-costs (swap one to Energy Regen if her Liberation isn't ready each rotation), ATK% on 1-costs, and keep a 1:2 Crit ratio.

ranked_weapons.name: Rime-Draped Sprouts
ranked_weapons.note: Her signature. ATK boost plus stacking Basic Attack DMG Bonus that converts into a 52% off-field Basic Attack DMG buff on Outro. Best in slot by far.

ranked_weapons.name: Stringmaster
ranked_weapons.note: Universal 5-star stick: Crit Rate substat, ATK stacking, and bonus ATK while off-field. Very strong on her.

ranked_weapons.name: Whispers of Sirens
ranked_weapons.note: Near-signature stats with Basic Attack DMG Bonus stacks, but conditional and tied to Echo Skill usage.

ranked_weapons.name: Cosmic Ripples
ranked_weapons.note: F2P-friendly 5-star from the Strongbox: Energy Regen, ATK, and stacking Basic Attack DMG Bonus. About 14% behind her signature.

echo_sets.name: Empyrean Anthem
echo_sets.note: Massive coordinated-attack DMG boost plus Energy Regen and an ATK buff for the on-field carry on Crit hits. New BiS; needs consistent Crit Rate.

echo_sets.name: Moonlit Clouds
echo_sets.note: Support-oriented: 22.5% ATK buff for the incoming Resonator on Outro plus Energy Regen. Good if nobody else holds it.

echo_sets.name: Freezing Frost
echo_sets.note: Max-personal-damage option if Zhezhi is your on-field/main DPS; all her hits count as Basic Attack DMG, so she procs it easily.

stat_priorities.note: Whichever balances her to a 1:2 Crit ratio; Empyrean Anthem wants consistent Crit Rate for the ATK buff.
Double Glacio DMG is optimal; swap one to Energy Regen if her Liberation isn't ready each rotation.

build.weapon_filler_note: 4-star stopgaps include Radiant Dawn and Fusion Accretion (both buff her on Resonance Skill), Augment (ATK on Liberation), and Variation (Concerto Energy). 3-star fallback: Guardian Rectifier.

teams.name: Premium: Carlotta + Zhezhi + Shorekeeper

members.name: Carlotta
members.note: Glacio carry whose damage lives in her Resonance Skill — Zhezhi's Outro buffs both Glacio and Resonance Skill DMG.

members.name: Zhezhi
members.note: Sets up coordinated attacks with Liberation, then Outros into Carlotta for the full buff package.

members.name: Shorekeeper
members.note: Stellarealm, team Crit buffs, and healing; her Crit Rate boost keeps Zhezhi's Empyrean Anthem ATK buff active.

teams.rotation: Carlotta starts to build Resonance Skill stacks, Shorekeeper deploys Stellarealm and buffs, Zhezhi runs a quick combo — Resonance Skills, Forte burst, then Liberation to leave coordinated attacks running — and Outros into Carlotta's full burst window with off-field support.

teams.name: Budget: Jinhsi + Zhezhi + Verina

members.name: Jinhsi
members.note: Spectro burst carry; Zhezhi's coordinated attacks feed Jinhsi's Incandescence stacks while the Resonance Skill Outro buffs her rotation.

members.name: Zhezhi
members.note: Coordinated attacks plus a Resonance Energy transfer to the next ally via her passive.

members.name: Verina
members.note: F2P-friendly sustain: team ATK buff and healing with low field-time requirements.

teams.rotation: Verina opens to build Concerto and buff ATK, Zhezhi builds Forte, casts Liberation for coordinated attacks, then Outros to transfer buffs and Energy into Jinhsi, who finishes with her full Incandescence-boosted Liberation combo.

teams.name: Alternative: Lingyang + Zhezhi + Verina

members.name: Lingyang
members.note: Glacio DPS who uses every part of Zhezhi's Outro — both the Glacio and Resonance Skill DMG buffs.

members.name: Zhezhi
members.note: Fast on-field setup and coordinated-attack uptime that matches Lingyang's quick pace.

members.name: Verina
members.note: Healing and ATK buff; opens rotations to charge Concerto quickly.

teams.rotation: Verina opens with Resonance Skill and Liberation to buff, Zhezhi fills her Concerto with Basic Attacks and Resonance Skills, casts Liberation for coordinated attacks, then swaps to Lingyang, who takes the field with the full Glacio and Skill DMG package active.

tier_badge.label: Strong niche Sub-DPS
tier_badge.note: Current v3.6-3.7 lists (Beebom Oct 2026, MMO Culture, Game8) all place her at A; older 1.x-era lists had her at S. Her ceiling is higher on favorable Glacio/ToA cycles.
